<issue>
Inline nested embeddable generates wrong column name when parent is null
### Describe the bug

When a parent inline embeddable is set to `null`, nested embeddables fail to generate a correct column name.

We were trying to upgrade from 6.4.15 to 6.6.x and our tests started failing.

### Reproduction

https://github.com/atachh/mikro-nested-embeddable-bug

### What driver are you using?

@mikro-orm/sqlite

### MikroORM version

next

### Node.js version

v24.11.0

### Operating system

MacOS

- [x] The provided reproduction is a [minimal reproducible example](https://stackoverflow.com/help/minimal-reproducible-example) of the bug.

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

content.text:
I changed `getEmbeddedPropertySnapshot` in `packages/core/src/utils/EntityComparator.ts` so a null inline embeddable also nulls the columns of its nested inline embeddables. I haven't run it or any tests, and I didn't try the reproduction repo.

**Cause (my diagnosis):** when the parent was null, the generated code only set its direct children to null. A nested embeddable got a single `ret[name] = null` entry, so its own leaf columns (the ones with the real column names) were never set to null.

**Fix:** the null branch now walks down through nested inline embeddables and nulls every child property it finds. It stops at JSON (`object`) embeddables, which are stored as a single column.

The fix is untested, so it needs a run of the embeddable test suites, plus a nested case with a null parent like the one in the reproduction.
